title: spring.config.import (consul)
description: The consul provider has no bound prefix; it is consumed via spring.config.import=optional:consul:<host>:<port>/<kv-path>?scheme=&token=&datacenter=&format=&retry-ms=

format.description: properties/yaml/json/toml; default inferred from the kv-path extension, else properties

retry-ms.description: watcher retry interval in milliseconds; default 2000
